distribution_status: Prepared notice texts and exact official source locations; integration into a final release, continued source access and any required source-archive publication remain release work.

debian.scope: All dpkg/status snapshots in existing layers, including packages upgraded or removed later.
debian.descriptor_verification: All exact source descriptors fully downloaded and verified against official content-addressed SHA-1. Full source parts have SHA-256 from those descriptors. OpenPGP signatures and full source archive content were not independently validated in this audit.

ubuntu.scope: All dpkg/status snapshots in fixed common Lean base layers. Official signed source descriptors retained without alteration; this audit does not claim to have verified their OpenPGP signatures or downloaded every full source archive.

python.license_scope: Python 3.12 LICENSE and bundled third-party notices retained from the actual image; dependencies separately listed.

pip.wheel_note: The actual wheel contains the pip MIT text but omits individual vendored library LICENSE files. Full original dependency notices from the same exact pip source release are supplied here as accompanying materials; do not label all vendored dependencies MIT.

lean_toolchain: Actual Lean LICENSE/LICENSES, mathlib/dependency notices and importGraph bundled graphology/sigma notices are retained in image-license-inventory.json. Elan and exact source pins continue in the existing toolchain records.
source_distribution_conditions: For GPL-3.0 network conveyance, apply section 6(d) with clearly documented equivalent source access and continued availability, or accompany binaries with the exact source archives.

For GPL-2.0 and other licenses, satisfy their specific corresponding-source provisions; do not apply GPL-3.0 section 6(d) as a blanket substitute. Prefer offering the exact source archives from the same release download location.
Offer complete original source parts, distribution patches and required build information; an upstream homepage or a license-only archive is insufficient.
This inventory records actual API/descriptor checks. It does not claim every source archive was downloaded, its full checksum verified or a system package rebuilt.
